parsed.answer: Both retrieved sources directly link RANK/RANKL signalling to the development of Aire-expressing medullary thymic epithelial cells. Source 3952288 shows RANKL signals from CD4+3− inducer cells promote maturation of RANK-expressing CD80−Aire− mTEC progenitors into CD80+Aire+ mTECs, and source 301838 shows Rankl+ lymphoid tissue inducer cells jointly direct the emergence of Aire+ mTECs in a Rank-mediated reciprocal link. The claim is therefore corroborated by the evidence.
